description: This file defines the 'Step1' class for the install controller of OpenCart, handling initialization of the first installation step by setting up language support, page titles, and loading header/footer components.

classes.name: Step1
classes.description: A controller class managing the first step of the OpenCart installation process, extending the base Controller class and responsible for preparing and rendering the install page.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executed for the install step 1 page; loads language strings, sets page title, prepares data, and renders the view.
